$description: Canonical Last Bench parent-brand design foundations. Exact brand masters live in assets/branding/. CLASS[Λ] and co.lab keep separate visual namespaces.

governance.brandPromise: From where you are. To what you can build.
governance.visualLaw: Dark for emotion. White for trust. Green for progress.

brand.name: Last Bench
brand.slogan: From Last Bench. To The World.
brand.logoConcept: Bench (where every journey begins) + rising arrow (the future we build together)

brandGreen.usage: Primary actions, progress, verified emphasis and restrained brand highlights

brandGreenBright.usage: Primary brand green on dark surfaces where additional luminance is required

charcoal.usage: Headlines, body copy and cinematic dark surfaces

pureWhite.usage: Raised light surfaces only; not the default page ground

sageGreen.usage: Tinted panels, soft borders and quiet supportive surfaces

softGray.usage: Muted text on dark and disabled states

appDarkBackground.usage: Existing authenticated app dark background; preserve until a deliberate app-theme migration

appDarkSurface.usage: Existing authenticated app raised dark surface

display.usage: Corporate and Education display copy; short declarative headlines with disciplined emphasis.

body.usage: Body copy, UI labels, form text and captions.

motion.rule: Motion must explain hierarchy, progress or spatial relationship; it must never block reading or conversion.

voice.pattern: Short declarative pairs with full stops as beats.
voice.emphasis: One dominant thought per headline; green emphasis is restrained and meaningful.
rules: never imply guaranteed visa, admission, scholarship, rebate, revenue or outcome

iconography.style: Thin-line, rounded joins, restrained detail, Charcoal/Green/White according to surface

motifs.topographicLines: Faint contour-line texture used as a secondary depth cue
motifs.journeyRoutes: Restrained path/route language for Education & Mobility
motifs.arrowMark: The rising-arrow idea may be used only through approved locked assets or approved geometric UI cues; never redraw the logo itself
motifs.cinematicDark: Near-black/charcoal emotional chapters with controlled green progress cues

lastBench.scope: Parent corporate brand, Education & Mobility, Journey OS and shared authenticated app shell

coLab.visualLanguage: Engineered/blueprint, monochrome discipline with approved accent system
